name: ModelVariant93_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant93_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a shaded dome of 137 points spins over a model part and fades, three lightning bolts reach from the slot towards a part vertex, the slot ambient dims while a textured flash grows over that vertex and a sixteen-ray star bursts from it, then eighty sparks rise in five groups and a textured wave sweeps through twice while the camera steps through seven presets); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the dome and packs one texture image, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first bolt, 4 until the ambient fade starts, 0 again until the sparks start, 1 after the sparks start, and 2 once the second wave has passed, restoring the slot ambient; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-110 and 240 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
